prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original modular 2D colony-game chibi character parts, front view only. Reference image 1 is the approved silhouette/proportions; reference image 2 is the level of crafted anime race-mod sprite detail. Produce new original human designs, no animal ears. Refined hand-drawn-looking cel shading, fine dark brown contours, grouped hair locks, restrained highlights, clear at small in-game sizes. Muted teal/olive/brown/cream palette. NO realistic human anatomy, no arms, hands or separated spread legs. No scenery, words, labels, watermark, panels, cast floor shadow. Genuinely transparent background. Three clearly separated equally spaced variant slots from left to right. Every slot uses exactly the same head center, eye line and scale for interchangeability. Keep the smaller eyes of reference 1, do not enlarge them. This sheet must contain ONLY the specified component, NOT assembled characters. FACIAL FEATURES overlay sheet ONLY: three front-facing anime sets, teal calm almond eyes, amber determined eyes, muted violet gentle eyes. Each set contains eyebrows, two eyes with fine upper lashes and layered irises/catchlights, tiny nose mark and tiny mouth. Transparent holes everywhere except these marks, absolutely NO skin, head silhouette, face patch, hair, clothing or body. Features should sit at the same coordinates relative to each slot. Wide landscape sheet, one row of three sets.
